subject.title: fix: recover stranded replies in message_tool_only mode (#85714)

question: Should stranded `message_tool_only` final recovery ship as this PR's opt-in `messages.strandedReplyRecovery` config, or should OpenClaw prefer a default guarded recovery direction after the successor branch is refreshed?
rationale: The branch adds a new user-facing config knob and changes a privacy-sensitive delivery boundary, while another open branch proposes the same user problem without the new config surface.

options.title: Prefer default guarded recovery
options.body: Use the successor direction after it is refreshed and revalidated, avoiding a new config knob while still fixing silent successful turns.

options.title: Accept opt-in recovery
options.body: Keep this PR's default-off setting, require external transport proof, and document that affected operators must explicitly enable recovery.

options.title: Stay warning-only
options.body: Reject automatic recovery and keep current main's diagnostic-only behavior, leaving users to choose automatic replies or stronger tool-calling models.

recommendation.title: Prefer default guarded recovery
recommendation.body: Use the successor direction after it is refreshed and revalidated, avoiding a new config knob while still fixing silent successful turns.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest visible history on the warning-only behavior and recent source-reply policy decisions for this path.
